gates.description: Spec.md technical architecture document must exist
At least one Architecture Decision Record must exist
Data consistency model must be chosen and documented
Failure modes for external dependencies must be identified
API contract must be committed before implementation
Performance budget (latency p50/p95/p99) must be defined
No multiple services sharing the same database tables

anti_patterns.description: Services that must be deployed together or have synchronous circular dependencies
Choosing technologies for personal interest rather than project needs
One service handling authentication, user management, billing, and notifications
Architecture that works in development but requires a PhD to operate
Multiple services reading/writing to the same database tables

escalation_triggers: Design decision requires choosing between conflicting quality attributes
Estimated implementation cost exceeds 3x original budget
Performance profiling shows the architecture cannot meet SLA at projected load
Security review reveals a fundamental flaw in the data flow
Two architects disagree on approach after structured comparison

input_requirements.description: PRD.md with product requirements from product manager

output_certifications: At least one ADR written with decision rationale
Failure modes identified for each external dependency
